title: Restriction and derived direct-image cube from an ordinary ring diagram
statement: Fix a prime l and finite index E in PadicAlgCl l. Let R,S be arbitrary coefficient systems and a:Change R S [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. Supply an ordinary ring diagram P:NativeScalarRingModel l E a [lem-sf-native-scalar-ring-model]. Let e_T and h_T be its explicitly constructed section-to-internal module equivalences. Let r_T be exact derived native restriction along a.map T [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction], and let c_T be derived restriction along the closure inclusion followed by restriction along the integer inclusion [def-sfb-derived-comap-lower-star-iso]. Then there are isomorphisms k_T:r_T⋙D(e_T)≅D(h_T)⋙c_T. For each g:U→V there are direct-image isomorphisms x:Rg_R*⋙D(e_V)≅D(e_U)⋙Rg_I* and y:Rg_S*⋙D(h_V)≅D(h_U)⋙Rg_C*. They make the cube commute with the inverse of the specified native restriction/direct-image comparison and the pasted inverses of the two condensed restriction/direct-image comparisons. Precisely, (v_native ≫ᵥ k_V.hom).whiskerLeft y.hom = (k_U.hom ≫ᵥ v_condensed).whiskerRight x.hom, with the four functors of each TwoSquare specified in the Lean statement. The conclusion concerns only restriction and direct image; it contains neither scalar extension nor scalar mates.

proof.text: Use comapComp to express restriction along the two condensed inclusions as restriction along their composite. Apply sectionModuleComapIso and transport through P.integral and P.closure. The scalar field of the supplied ordinary ring diagram makes these identity-on-abelian-sections maps linear. This gives an ordinary restriction isomorphism at every scheme.

Use integral_natural and closure_natural to identify the inverse-image adjunct ring maps. The internal/section equivalence transports direct image to evaluation on the same base-change object, so the identity on sections gives the two ordinary direct-image comparisons. Both routes of the ordinary restriction/direct-image cube agree on underlying abelian sections. Faithfulness of the section-module forgetful functor proves the ordinary cube.

Localize the exact ordinary restriction isomorphism to obtain k. Right derive the ordinary direct-image comparisons using the canonical composite isomorphisms. The ordinary module equivalences are exact and preserve K-injective representatives, so the resulting x and y are isomorphisms for all unbounded derived objects.

Normalize all comparisons by the canonical right-derived cochain units. The uniqueness characterization of proEtaleRingRestrictionDerivedDirectImage identifies the native face; the two condensed faces are derivedComapLowerStarIso. Pasting the normalizations and the ordinary cube gives the same equality after precomposition with a resolution unit. Evaluate on a K-injective representative and cancel its invertible unit. Naturality extends the equality to all derived objects, giving the displayed TwoSquare equation. No scalar-extension mate is used or assumed invertible.

lean.statement:
theorem nativeScalarRestrictionCube
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Index l (PadicAlgCl l))
    {R S : PurCompactSupport.Coefficients.{u}} (a : PurCompactSupport.Change R S)
    (P : NativeScalarRingModel l E a) :
    ∃ k : ∀ T : Scheme.{u},
        (proEtaleRingRestrictScalars (a.map T)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
            (P.integralEquivalence T).functor.mapDerivedCategory ≅
          (P.closureEquivalence T).functor.mapDerivedCategory ⋙
            nativeScalarCompositeRestriction l E T,
      ∀ {U V : Scheme.{u}} (g : U ⟶ V),
        ∃ (x : proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage g (R.ring V) (R.ring U) (R.pull g) ⋙
              (P.integralEquivalence V).functor.mapDerivedCategory ≅
            (P.integralEquivalence U).functor.mapDerivedCategory ⋙
              CondensedRing.moduleObjectDerivedPushforward
                (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj l E.1) g)
          (y : proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage g (S.ring V) (S.ring U) (S.pull g) ⋙
              (P.closureEquivalence V).functor.mapDerivedCategory ≅
            (P.closureEquivalence U).functor.mapDerivedCategory ⋙
              CondensedRing.moduleObjectDerivedPushforward
                (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj l) g),
          ((nativeRingRestrictionSquare a g ≫ᵥ
              TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (k V).hom).whiskerLeft y.hom) =
            ((TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (k U).hom ≫ᵥ
                nativeScalarCompositeRestrictionSquare l E g).whiskerRight x.hom)
